an8.20:7.4: The fact that, mendicants, the ocean gradually slants, slopes, and inclines, with no abrupt precipice;
an8.20:8.2: The fact that, mendicants, many great beings live in the ocean—such beings as leviathans, leviathan-gulpers, leviathan-gulper-gulpers, titans, dragons, and centaurs; living in the ocean are life-forms a hundred leagues long … five hundred leagues long;
an8.20:9.5: The fact that, mendicants, in this teaching and training the penetration to enlightenment comes from gradual training, progress, and practice, not abruptly;
an8.20:9.9: The fact that, mendicants, great beings live in this teaching and training—such beings as the stream-enterer and the one practicing to realize the fruit of stream-entry … the perfected one, and the one practicing for perfection;
